purpose: Auditable record of AI-assisted maintainer review used during the US Regulation Assurance Lift. When a use case was promoted to status=verified or had its compliance assurance re-graded as part of this initiative, the change was made on the basis of AI-assisted research + maintainer attestation rather than a credentialed human SME sign-off.
disclaimer: This file is NOT a substitute for data/provenance/sme-signoffs.json and must not be read as credentialed human subject-matter-expert review. Schema semantics define status=verified as 'SME-signed-off'; setting it from AI review + maintainer attestation is an accepted deviation explicitly authorised by the maintainer for this initiative. Each record below states the concrete checks performed so the deviation is auditable.

checks: audit-compliance-mappings PASSED (0 errors, golden 52/52, baseline clean)
SPL uses only known commands/functions (spl-hallucinations safe)
SPL references resolve — sourcetypes declared in dataSources; no join (spl-references safe)
UC id 22.10.59 is gap-free next in subcategory 22.10
controlTest positive + negative scenarios present; attackTechnique T1562.008
reviews.rationale: Genuinely sole-sufficient audit-control mechanism: reconciles the in-scope ePHI system inventory against live audit telemetry to prove every system is RECORDING (silent sources surface as explicit GAP rows) and produces the periodic per-source activity-volume EXAMINATION the clause requires. Splunk is the primary control, so full is defensible. See the UC assurance_rationale.

checks: assurance_rationale rewritten to justify partial (standalone detective control over role-inconsistent ePHI activity)
reviews.rationale: UC reconciles Epic audit activity against the authoritative HR-role register and flags least-privilege violations — a standalone detective control giving substantive (not merely contributing) evidence the access-control standard operates. Graded partial, not full, because the standard's preventive implementation specifications are enforced by other controls.

checks: assurance_rationale rewritten to justify partial (standalone detective control over the authentication mechanism)
reviews.rationale: UC surfaces clustered smart card / certificate logon failures indicating weak, expired, or attacked credentials used to reach ePHI — substantive monitoring evidence of the authentication mechanism. Graded partial, not full, because authentication itself is enforced by the PKI / Kerberos / MFA stack.
